status: closed after declared experiments; no further calls invoked
scope: Saved admitted/conditional/incomplete sources; Luna-only isolated input/effort/topology comparison. No providers, FX, request mutation, runtime defaults or frontend changes.
execution: Start matched original/candidate medium admitted and conditional sentinels; independently review before continued low/topology. Interleave arms and reverse order on repeat; log actual order and cache conditions. Candidate changes are versioned and consume this same envelope. Stop a clearly unhelpful variant with explicit evidence; preserve failed calls. No automatic extension.
recovery: Use shared run_attempts: one initial final-document generation plus at most one correction for recoverable failed checks; better recoverable draft, correction wins ties; preserve annotated findings. Worker failure is explicit topology failure, no silent fallback or worker repair allowance.
quality: Independent source/composition review before timing-based recommendation. Material: wrong factual/date/price comparison, misleading eligible landscape, reference identity mismatch, invented completeness/booking protection or material missing uncertainty. Minor wording is separately reported. Mechanical checks do not prove narrative truth.
timing: Actual Results-only wall time includes source parsing, preparation/workspace, exact counting, worker critical path, composition, checking/resolution and actual correction; first text is not first usable display. Per-call timeout is not a whole-workflow deadline.
cost_basis: Estimate using recorded 2026-10-25 Luna rates: ordinary input0.10, cached0.01, cache-write0.125, output0.50 USD per million. Count billing/native Codex excluded; estimate not invoice.
claim_limits: Small development comparison; no SLA threshold supplied, statistical reliability/holdout, M2 owner presentation acceptance, frontend delivery, M3 qualification or runtime multi-agent adoption. Diagnostic artifacts are noncanonical; source evidence preserved. Owner decides what to keep/cut.
